title: Fundamental theorem of calculus in one coordinate on the open unit cube of Euclid (k+1)
statement: Let k ∈ ℕ, i ∈ Fin (k+1), and let G : Euclid (k+1) → ℝ be C¹. Write Q^d := {y ∈ Euclid d : 0 < y_j < 1 for all j} (Lebesgue measure) and e_i := EuclideanSpace.single i 1. For c ∈ ℝ and y' ∈ Euclid k, let insertNth i c y' ∈ Euclid (k+1) be the point (toLp ∘ Fin.insertNth i c ∘ ofLp) with i-th coordinate c and remaining coordinates y' in order. Then y ↦ DG(y)e_i is integrable on Q^{k+1}, and ∫_{Q^{k+1}} DG(y)e_i dy = ∫_{Q^k} G(insertNth i 1 y') dy' − ∫_{Q^k} G(insertNth i 0 y') dy'.
lean_statement: ∀ (k : ℕ) (i : Fin (k + 1)) (G : Euclid (k + 1) → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 G → IntegrableOn (fun y => fderiv ℝ G y (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))) {y : Euclid (k + 1) | ∀ j, 0 < y j ∧ y j < 1} ∧ ∫ y in {y : Euclid (k + 1) | ∀ j, 0 < y j ∧ y j < 1}, fderiv ℝ G y (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) = (∫ y in {y : Euclid k | ∀ j, 0 < y j ∧ y j < 1}, G (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.insertNth i (1 : ℝ) (WithLp.ofLp y)))) - ∫ y in {y : Euclid k | ∀ j, 0 < y j ∧ y j < 1}, G (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.insertNth i (0 : ℝ) (WithLp.ofLp y)))
